title: compact-streaming-bridge-auth-presets-and-iterator-polish
author: Evelyn Park
body: Context: Multiple SDK teams asked for a lighter-weight streaming bridge that standardizes auth preset selection, improves retry ergonomics, and tightens iterator ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go. Motivation: Reduce duplicated auth selection logic in customer code, make streaming resume/heartbeat interactions predictable across SDKs, and align minor API ergonomics so feature parity is easier to maintain. Summary of changes (high level): 1) Introduced "compact auth presets" library (internal/auth/presets.go + sdks/* glue) that codifies three supported auth profiles: direct-token, delegated-refresh, and prefetched-lease. 2) Added a small streaming-bridge shim (sdks/typescript/src/stream/bridge.ts, sdks/python/redwood/_stream_bridge.py, sdks/go/stream/bridge.go) that normalizes resume tokens and exposes a tiny ergonomic async iterator / generator surface for pull/push streams. 3) Reworked retry configuration shape to use RetryProfile (a compact declaration that ships with SDK defaults) and added back-compat adapters to accept the previous backoff shape. 4) Tightened iterator behavior: iterators now expose an isPaused() hint and a graceful close() that flushes pending resume state. 5) Added telemetry hooks for reauth attempts (telemetry keys: sdk.auth.reauth_attempt, sdk.auth.fallback_used) and added unit/integration tests around heartbeat/reauth races. 6) Version bumps: python-sdk -> 1.31.0, typescript-sdk -> 1.28.5, go-sdk -> 1.9.2. Compatibility notes: This is intentionally non-breaking for typical consumers. The old retry config is still accepted via an adapter layer; however, a handful of minor optional parameter names were renamed for clarity in TS (maxRetryWindow -> retryWindowMs) and an alias is preserved during the transition. Migration notes: If you supply custom retry config structs, update to RetryProfile or rely on the adapter. If you previously relied on internal resume token shapes, switch to passing the resume token string or use the bridge's resumeHint accessor. Tests and QA: Added 48 new unit tests across sdks/python and sdks/typescript, and 6 small integration harness scenarios that run against the local streaming canary in CI. Manual verification included cross-language smoke (py->ts->go examples) and a short soak on the perf-canary cluster for 4 hours. Docs: Added upgrade guidance at docs/upgrade-sdks.md and small usage examples in examples/streaming. Why this is unique: Instead of pushing language-specific divergent ergonomics, the PR creates a compact, opinionated bridge and small public primitives that are identical in behavior across languages, making future parity work incremental. Related work: builds on ENG-2120 (stream resume spec) and complements ENG-3373 (retry-presets RFC).

review_comments: Daniel Ortiz: Please justify why we chose three presets instead of keeping the larger matrix; note that customers often have hybrid flows. Author reply: Short answer - we want an opinionated surface to reduce error modes; the presets are extensible and a 'custom' preset path is available. Marta Li: Can we preserve the old retry config names for one release to make migration easier? Response: Yes, adapter added and test coverage included. Rohit Anand: Small nit - rename maxRetryWindow to retryWindowMs in TS to clarify units. Author: Implemented and added alias; tests updated. Daniel Ortiz: Approve after green CI. Marta Li: Approve. Rohit Anand: Approve. Merge: squash and merge after release checklist completed.

release_notes: - Introduce compact auth presets and a small streaming bridge to unify resume/reauth behavior across SDKs. - Add RetryProfile as the recommended retry config shape; adapter for legacy shapes included. - Expose ergonomic iterator helpers: isPaused() and close() to flush resume state. - Add telemetry for auth reattempts and fallback usage. - SDK version bumps: python 1.31.0, typescript 1.28.5, go 1.9.2.
